verdict.rationale: Forter publishes a structured API reference under docs.forter.com/reference (Order v3, order status, webhooks, environments) and offers a sandbox/TEST environment for verifying integrations, which supports exploring and testing the API. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or has runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' console in the reference, runnable or copyable code examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
